suggestions: I'm grateful for a bug report that turned out to be a typo in a config file, not the disaster I dreaded on the walk to my desk.
I'm thankful for the mosque's first azan drifting in through the window before the rest of the block wakes up.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that actually made the PR better instead of just nitpicking indentation.
I'm thankful for my mum saving me a plate of nasi lemak even though I told her not to wait up.
I'm grateful for CI going green on the first try after a rebase I was sure would break everything.
I'm thankful for the LRT actually being on time on the one day I overslept.
I'm grateful for a manager who said 'take the day off' and meant it, no follow-up Slack message an hour later.
I'm thankful for the uncle at the mamak remembering my order without me having to say it twice.
I'm grateful for a Friday that stayed jam-packed until the very end but still left enough time to make it to the surau before the khutbah started.
I'm thankful for a Wi-Fi outage that forced me to close my laptop and actually eat lunch like a person.
I'm grateful for my younger sister sending a voice note just to complain about her day, like nothing's changed since we were kids.
I'm thankful for a production incident that got resolved before anyone above me even noticed it happened.
I'm grateful for the smell of rain hitting hot tarmac on the drive home.
I'm thankful for a payslip that cleared on time and let me top up my parents' phone credit without thinking twice.
I'm grateful for the first sip of teh o ais after a meeting that ran way too long.
